verdict.CONFIRMED: not WORSE, and point deltas within v7's no_point_regression (margin MAE <= 0, Brier <= +0.0005, log loss <= +0.0015), and |mean actual - model| on neutral-site games smaller for v7.1 than for v7
verdict.NOT_CONFIRMED: neither: v7.1 is packaged as the routed challenger and the shortfall is reported
verdict.WORSE (stop): v7.1 - v7 on all scored games: margin MAE delta CI low > 0, or moneyline Brier delta CI low > 0, or log loss delta CI low > 0. Then no v7.1 artifact is routed; v7 stays the routed challenger and the operator decides
